description: Test suite for auto-responder functionality in Mattermost server channels, including setting, disabling, and sending auto-responses.

methods.name: TestSetAutoResponderStatus
methods.description: Tests enabling and disabling auto-responder status and verifying user status updates.

methods.name: TestDisableAutoResponder
methods.description: Tests disabling the auto-responder and verifying the notify props.

methods.name: TestSendAutoResponseIfNecessary
methods.description: Tests the logic for sending auto responses under various conditions, including enabled/disabled, non-DM channels, bots, and recent responses.

methods.name: TestSendAutoResponseSuccess
methods.description: Verifies successful auto response sending and post creation.

methods.name: TestSendAutoResponseSuccessOnThread
methods.description: Verifies auto response sending on threaded posts.

methods.name: TestSendAutoResponseFailure
methods.description: Verifies that auto responses are not sent when conditions are not met.
